comment: Prehistoric/archaeological story pins (era "prehistoric" or tag "archaeology") with more than 1 decimal (0.1°, about 10 km; was 2 until 2026-10-11) are rounded by apply-story-overrides.mjs. Slugs/History ids below are exempt (tier C public sites, or already county-level).
forceComment: Rounded even though not prehistoric/archaeology: their pin is the protected Eskippakithiki / Indian Old Fields site.
markerComment: KHS markers whose sign coordinates equal a protected site (1274 Indian Old Fields = Eskippakithiki). apply-story-overrides rounds their lat/lon only in markers.phase1.json, markers.geojson and both search indexes, and lists them as marker:<n> in protected-pins.json.
